Test Description: Assert hardware reset (rst_n_i=0). Monitor AHB bus signals: sys_hready, sys_hresp, sys_htrans, active_slave_q.
Expected Result: sys_hready drives high (1'b1) per AHB-Lite specification; sys_hresp drives low (OKAY); active_slave_q drives 5'b0; bus holds in idle state.
External Interface / Signal Names: None (Internal System Bus: sys_hready, sys_hresp, sys_htrans)

Test Scenario: Bus Protocol Recovery Following Reset Deassertion
Test Description: Release rst_n_i to 1'b1. Verify that first NONSEQ transfer from core LSU/IFU executes without protocol violation.
Expected Result: Bus accepts valid address phase on positive clock edge; sys_hready stays asserted; zero cycle stall on first post-reset transaction.

Test Description: Core master issues single NONSEQ read to DCCM address 0x00000028 with sys_hwrite=0, sys_htrans=2'b10, sys_hsize=2'b10 (word).
Expected Result: Address sampled in cycle N; data phase in cycle N+1 returns 32-bit word on sys_hrdata with sys_hready=1 and sys_hresp=0.
External Interface / Signal Names: None (Internal AHB Bus: sys_haddr, sys_hrdata, sys_hready)

Test Description: Core master issues single NONSEQ write to DCCM address 0x00000028 with payload 0x12345678, sys_hwrite=1, sys_htrans=2'b10.
Expected Result: Address phase accepted; data 0x12345678 captured on sys_hwdata during data phase; memory cell updated; subsequent read verifies data integrity.
External Interface / Signal Names: None (Internal AHB Bus: sys_haddr, sys_hwdata, sys_hready)

Test Description: Perform byte write (sys_hsize=3'b000) of 0x5A to DCCM address 0x00000020. Read back byte.
Expected Result: Byte-lane strobe steers byte to target byte address; adjacent bytes in word remain unmodified; read back returns exact byte 0x5A.

Test Description: Perform halfword write (sys_hsize=3'b001) of 0xA55A to aligned address 0x00000024. Read back halfword.
Expected Result: Halfword correctly written across target 2-byte lane; read returns 0xA55A; unaddressed halfword in 32-bit word preserved.

Test Description: Execute back-to-back 32-bit word writes and reads across DCCM memory range (0x00000000 to 0x00000400).
Expected Result: All 32 bits written and read back with 100% bit parity; zero data corruption across memory array.

Test Description: VeeR LSU master issues 64-bit transfer (sys_hsize=3'b011) to DCCM memory. Monitor sys_hwdata[63:0] and sys_hrdata[63:0].
Expected Result: Full 64-bit double-word payload transferred in single clock cycle across sys_hwdata / sys_hrdata without splitting into multiple beats.

Test Description: Perform 32-bit write to peripheral address with addr[2]=1 (e.g., UART_IER at 0x40002004 or SPI_SR at 0x40001064).
Expected Result: AHB-to-AXI bridge steers upper 32-bit word from sys_hwdata[63:32] to peripheral 32-bit slave wdata[31:0]; peripheral receives exact write payload.

Test Description: Issue transactions to DCCM unified alias (0x00000000-0x0000FFFF) and native base (0xF0040000-0xF004FFFF).
Expected Result: hsel_dccm asserts high exclusively; active_slave_q routes dccm_hrdata and dccm_hready to sys bus; other slave selects remain 0.

Test Description: Issue transactions to SPI legacy base 0x40001000 and target base 0x40006000.
Expected Result: hsel_spi asserts high exclusively; u_spi_bridge activates and arbitrates with SPI AXI slave; transaction completes with sys_hready=1.
External Interface / Signal Names: None (Internal Decoder: hsel_spi; observes spi_clk_o, spi_cs_n_o)

Test Description: Issue transactions to UART legacy base 0x40002000 and target base 0x40000000.
Expected Result: hsel_uart asserts high exclusively; u_uart_bridge forwards AXI-Lite transfer to axi_uart_top; responses multiplexed to sys_hrdata.
External Interface / Signal Names: None (Internal Decoder: hsel_uart; observes uart_tx_o, uart_rx_i)

Test Description: Issue transactions to I2C legacy base 0x40003000 and target base 0x40008000.
Expected Result: hsel_i2c asserts high exclusively; u_i2c_bridge translates AHB transfer to Wishbone cycles; ack returned to sys_hready.
External Interface / Signal Names: None (Internal Decoder: hsel_i2c; observes i2c_scl, i2c_sda)

Test Scenario: Address Decoding to DMA CSR Subsystem (0x40000C00)
Test Description: Issue transactions to DMA CSR address range (0x40000C00 - 0x40000FFF).
Expected Result: hsel_dma_csr asserts high exclusively; u_dma_csr_bridge routes transaction to csr_dma registers; DMA configuration registers update cleanly.

Test Scenario: Pipelined Address and Data Phase Execution
Test Description: Execute pipelined transfer sequence: Address phase of Transfer 2 coincides with Data phase of Transfer 1.
Expected Result: Pipelining operates without bubbles; each beat completes in 1 cycle when sys_hready=1; bus throughput achieves maximum bandwidth.

Test Description: Perform read/write to highest word boundary in 64KB DCCM range (0x0000FFFC).
Expected Result: Transfer acknowledged with sys_hready=1; data stored and retrieved accurately; no address aliasing into peripheral memory space.

Test Scenario: Subsystem Memory Map Boundary Discrimination (UART vs DMA CSR)
Test Description: Access top of UART range (0x40000BFC) followed immediately by bottom of DMA CSR range (0x40000C00).
Expected Result: Decoder cleanly switches hsel_uart for 0x40000BFC and hsel_dma_csr for 0x40000C00 without simultaneous assertion or bus contention.

Test Description: Access peripheral slave that requires multiple clock cycles to complete transaction (e.g., Wishbone I2C bridge).
Expected Result: Slave pulls sys_hready low; master extends data phase across wait cycles; data captured only when sys_hready rises high.

Test Scenario: Unmapped Address Access & Default Slave Response
Test Description: Master initiates read/write transfer to unmapped address space (e.g., 0x50000000).
Expected Result: Default slave decodes transfer; returns bounded response with sys_hready=1, sys_hresp=0, sys_hrdata=0; system does not freeze or deadlock.

Test Description: Inject error condition causing slave to assert sys_hresp=1.
Expected Result: AHB-Lite 2-cycle error response protocol observed: cycle 1 has sys_hready=0, sys_hresp=1; cycle 2 has sys_hready=1, sys_hresp=1; master aborts transfer.
External Interface / Signal Names: None (Internal AHB Protocol Signals: sys_hready, sys_hresp)

Test Description: Trigger DMA transfer while CPU master is in IDLE. Monitor AHB bus arbiter.
Expected Result: Arbiter grants bus to DMA master; dma_haddr, dma_hwrite, dma_hwdata routed to sys bus; DMA successfully performs DCCM transfer.

Test Scenario: Concurrent CPU DCCM Access & DMA Bus Activity
Test Description: DMA performs multi-beat transfer to DCCM destination buffer while CPU concurrently executes instructions from ICCM/ROM and accesses separate DCCM scratch region.
Expected Result: Arbiter multiplexes bus access; both DMA transfer and CPU compute loop complete with 100% data integrity and zero memory corruption.

Test Scenario: Bus Master Handover After DMA Transfer Completion
Test Description: DMA finishes last transfer beat and deasserts dma_busy. CPU resumes AHB bus requests.
Expected Result: Arbiter cleanly restores CPU as default active bus master on the next clock cycle with zero bus contention or orphaned transactions.
